texts.preamble: Shankaragowda S Kanthalagavi vs The State Of Karnataka on 12 November, 2025 Author: H.T.Narendra Prasad Bench: H.T.Narendra Prasad -1- Nc: 2025:Khc-K:6747-Db Wp No. 202849 of 2025 C/W Wp No. 202837 of 2025 Wp No. 202838 of 2025 Hc-Kar In The High Court Of Karnataka Kalaburagi Bench Dated This The 12Th Day Of November, 2025 Present The Hon'Ble Mr. Justice H.T.Narendra Prasad And The Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Tyagaraja N. Inavally Writ Petition No. 202849 Of 2025 (S-Ksat) C/W Writ Petition No. 202837 Of 2025 Writ Petition No. 202838 Of 2025 In W.P.No.202849/2025 Between: Shankaragowda S.Kanthalagavi S/O. Shivanagowda, Aged About 53 Years, Working As Food Safety Officer, Digitally signed by (Now Under Illegal Order
texts.facts: The case of the petitioners is that petitioners are working as Food Safety Officers in the Commissionerate of Food Safety at various places. Initially, they were the employees of Health and Family Welfare Department. They were working as Food Safety Officers since 2011 in pursuance to the Notification dated 30.07.2011 and Notification dated 05.08.2011. Vide Government Order dated 23.07.2025 and Official Memorandum dated 25.07.2025, the petitioners were relieved as Food Safety Officers and are directed to report to duty at the office of Commissioner Health and Family Welfare Service as Junior/Senior Health Inspectors and to seek further postings. 4. The petitioners in all these petitions have sought for interim order staying the Government Order dated 23.07.2025 and Official Memorandum dated 25.07.2025. The Tribunal has refused to grant Shankaragowda S Kanthalagavi vs The State Of Karnataka on 12 November, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/129618510/ 5 exparte interim order. Being aggrieved by the same, the petitioners are before this Court. Learned counsel appearing for the petitioners submitted that similarly placed employees have approached the Karnataka State Administrative Tribunal, Bengaluru in Application Nos.3561-3579/2025, wherein the Tribunal has refused to grant interim order. Learned counsel for the petitioners submitted that as on today, the petitioners have not been relieved from their posts.
